value.rationale: A 2026 structural study singles out local candidate dominance as sufficient under restricted domains. This result sharply measures how the local obstruction and its genuinely nonlocal two-candidate complement decay under an unrestricted impartial approval model, identifies the k-versus-m-k boundary, and supplies finite-n bounds and an explicit nonlocal witness. This is a quantitative structural distinction, not just a numerical census or arbitrary slice.
